turns.question: What is the railway initiative?
turns.answer:
The Sustainable Solutions Lab (SSL) is collaborating with the Massachusetts Department of Transportation (MassDOT) on the Cape Cod Rail Resilience Research Project [1]. This initiative aims to improve rail safety and climate resilience along the Cape Main Line by integrating advanced technology with stakeholder-engaged research methods [1]. **Leadership and Collaboration**
The project is led by Carlos Velásquez, who serves as a project manager at MassDOT and is a PhD candidate at UMass Boston [1]. This collaborative effort brings together experts from MassDOT, UMass Boston, and AECOM [1]. **Methodology and Background**
The initiative was launched in response to a 300-foot rail embankment collapse in East Sandwich in 2020, an event attributed to climate change-induced drought conditions [1]. With funding from the United States Department of Transportation (USDOT), the team employs several technical strategies, including:
- Utilizing drones for mapping and sensors to monitor water levels [1].
- Combining aerial surveys, hydrological drought analysis, and real-time monitoring systems at three pilot study sites [1].
